parsed.summary: Tracing the drawing against the specification, every functional element matches: the XT60-M/10 mΩ shunt/INA219 (0x40) sensing path, the MIC26903 buck (15 µH, 9 A @ 5 V, divider yielding ~5 V) and LD39200 3V3 LDO, both STM32 MCUs with 25 MHz HSE, the BMI088/IIS2MDCTR/MPRLS/TMP100/EEPROM set on the NAVC bus, the PCA9685/W25N01/EEPROM set on the FCC bus, and the CH330 bridges. The only apparent textual mismatch — the PCA9685 being addressed at 0x41 (A0 tied to +3.3V) instead of the spec table's 0x40 — is required to avoid an address collision with the INA219 (0x40) that shares the same SCL/SDA net (NET0001/NET0037), so the spec-table value is a transcription error rather than a board deviation. The barometer RESET/EOC swap is present exactly as the documented known bug and is not reported. No drawing-supported electrical deviation was found.
